name: Other platforms — IOC starters
description: One working starter query per remaining dialect: SentinelOne, QRadar, CrowdStrike Falcon Event Search, Rapid7 InsightIDR, Sumo Logic, Devo, Securonix, ArcSight, NetWitness, Graylog, osquery-style SQL, grep and PowerShell. Each template declares its own dialect, so a single pack covers them all.

templates.name: SentinelOne — connections to the IP addresses
templates.description: Deep Visibility query. Operators are case sensitive.

templates.name: SentinelOne — files matching the hashes
templates.description: Target file hash across all Deep Visibility event types.

templates.name: SentinelOne — requests to the domains
templates.description: Case insensitive substring match, so subdomains are caught too.

templates.name: CrowdStrike Event Search — connections to the IP addresses
templates.description: Legacy Falcon Event Search, which speaks a Splunk derived language.
templates.body:
event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| table _time, ComputerName, UserName, FileName, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort
| sort - _time

templates.name: CrowdStrike Event Search — processes matching the hashes
QRadar — events involving the IP addresses
templates.description: Ariel query. The trailing LAST clause is the time filter.
templates.body:
SELECT QIDNAME(qid) AS event, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) AS source, sourceip, destinationip, username, starttime
FROM events
WHERE sourceip {{op}} ({{iocs}}) OR destinationip {{op}} ({{iocs}})
ORDER BY starttime DESC
LAST 7 DAYS

templates.name: QRadar — payload containing the domains
templates.description: Falls back to a payload search when no normalised URL property exists.
templates.body:
SELECT QIDNAME(qid) AS event, sourceip, destinationip, UTF8(payload) AS raw, starttime
FROM events
WHERE {{field}} MATCHES '{{iocs|regex}}'
ORDER BY starttime DESC
LAST 7 DAYS

templates.name: Rapid7 InsightIDR — events from the IP addresses
Sumo Logic — messages mentioning the IP addresses
templates.body:
_index=* 
| where _raw matches /{{iocs|regex}}/
| count by _sourceCategory, _sourceHost
| sort by _count

templates.name: Devo — web activity towards the IP addresses
templates.body:
from siem.logtrust.web.activity
where {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
select eventdate, srcIp, destinationIp, url, statusCode

templates.name: Securonix Spotter — activity involving the IP addresses
ArcSight — events involving the IP addresses
NetWitness — sessions involving the IP addresses
templates.description: NetWitness takes a bare comma separated meta list, with no brackets.

templates.name: Graylog — messages involving the IP addresses
osquery / Live Discover — processes matching the hashes
templates.description: Works on Sophos Live Discover, Fleet and plain osquery with the hash table joined.
templates.body:
SELECT p.pid, p.name, p.path, p.cmdline, h.sha256, h.md5
FROM processes p
JOIN hash h ON h.path = p.path
WHERE {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})

templates.name: grep — sweep a log directory
templates.description: The universal fallback: every indicator is regex escaped and joined into one alternation.

templates.name: PowerShell — search the Windows event log
templates.description: Runs on a single host when no EDR telemetry is available.
templates.body:
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName='Security','System','Application'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-7) } |
  Where-Object { $_.Message -match '{{iocs|regex}}' } |
  Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, LogName, Message |
  Format-List
